drivingQuestion: What does the priest say at the border and on the battlefield?
outcomeNote: Opening of a baraita that continues in sotah.sugya243

segments.he: ״אַל יֵרַךְ לְבַבְכֶם אַל תִּירְאוּ כּוּ׳״. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: פַּעֲמַיִים מְדַבֵּר עִמָּם, אַחַת בַּסְּפָר, וְאַחַת בַּמִּלְחָמָה. בַּסְּפָר מַה הוּא אוֹמֵר —
segments.en: With respect to the mishna’s comments about the verse: «“Let not your heart faint; fear not,» nor be alarmed, and do not be terrified of them” (Deuteronomy 20:3), «the Sages taught» (Tosefta 7:18): The priest «speaks with them twice, one» time when they are gathered for war «at the border, and one» time when they are «on the battlefield» itself. When they are «at the border, what does he say?»
